# Fixture sources and licences

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `circle.svg` | hand-authored (`<circle>` element) | CC0 / public domain |
| `square.svg` | hand-authored | CC0 / public domain |
| `two_strokes.svg` | hand-authored | CC0 / public domain |
| `transformed.svg` | hand-authored (`<g transform>`) | CC0 / public domain |
| `offset_viewbox.svg` | hand-authored (nonzero viewBox min) | CC0 / public domain |
| `lineart_cc0.svg` | **original**, generated by this project: a 600-point closed curve `r = 100·(1 + 0.3·cos 5θ)` centered at (200,200). Not copied from any third party. | CC0 1.0 (dedicated to the public domain by the author) |

`lineart_cc0.svg` is a stroke-based (unfilled) single closed path used as an
AC-2 **smoke test**. Its radial profile has only a few non-zero harmonics, so a
truncated reconstruction is near-exact.

## Real web-fetched drawing (AC-2 proper)

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `ethanol_pd.svg` | Wikimedia Commons, `File:Ethanol-2D-skeletal.svg` — page `https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ethanol-2D-skeletal.svg`, file `https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/82/Ethanol-2D-skeletal.svg` (downloaded 2026-10-15) | **Public domain** (per Commons `imageinfo` `LicenseShortName`) |

`ethanol_pd.svg` is a real, genuinely **stroke-based, multi-stroke** (5 subpaths)
line drawing with real path segments — the kind of input the project targets. It
reconstructs at **0.0138 % of its larger dimension at M=512** (well under the
0.5 % AC-2 bound). Transform handling is covered separately by `transformed.svg`
and the `test_sampling_is_scale_invariant` test, since the probed public-domain
drawings that used `<g transform>` were fill-based rather than stroke-based.
